sections.title: Methodology
sections.body: This tool does not use complex machine learning. The Dependency Level is calculated transparently using three factors: Brunson's scoring average over his last 10 games, the historical difficulty of the opponent, and home/away splits. These factors determine the likely scoring band, which is then mapped against historical Knicks win rates to assess how desperately a big night is needed.

demoSteps: Review the Highlights to see Brunson's current 10-game baseline and the most critical upcoming matchup.
Scan the 'Upcoming Schedule Dependency' table to see how the offensive burden shifts depending on the opponent and venue.
Check the 'Win Likelihood' chart to understand the historical context behind the dependency ratings.
Read the Methodology section to confirm the logic is straightforward and avoids black-box sports betting math.
notes: The UI should look distinctly analytical and dense, avoiding generic dashboard widgets or flashy charts.
All data in V1 must be powered by local JSON fixtures to ensure the demo never breaks during presentations.
Future iterations may include an adapter for real API data, but the internal schema must remain identical to the local fixtures.
